subject: Medford High School Vision Committee Relaunch
overview: The committee met to discuss the redesign and relaunch of the Medford High School Vision Committee to address long-term facility and educational needs. They decided to establish a formal mission and outreach strategy before soliciting new members to ensure the committee reflects a diverse cross-section of the community.

items.title: Remote Participation and Call to Order
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn opened the meeting and provided instructions for public participation via remote technological means.

items.title: Facility and Vocational Program Updates
items.summary: Staff presented a comprehensive review of recent renovations and upgrades to Medford High School and the vocational technical school, including improvements to the HVAC system, science labs, and various specialized workshops.

items.title: Vision Committee Scope and Diversity Discussion
items.summary: The committee debated the purpose of the Vision Committee, with members questioning whether its scope should be limited to physical plant renovations or expanded to include social, emotional, and academic goals. Participants emphasized that the previous group lacked diversity and stressed the need for intentional outreach to BIPOC stakeholders, students with disabilities, and low-income families to ensure equitable representation.

items.title: Formalizing the Committee Charge
items.summary: Members agreed that the committee's 'charge' or formal mission must be defined before opening the application process so that volunteers understand the expected time commitment and goals. Approved a motion for the Superintendent to compile a formal charge based on a draft by Member Ruseau that focuses on carbon-neutral options for a 50-year vision.
